points.message: Diamond has covalent bonding and a giant lattice structure.
Many strong covalent bonds between carbon atoms must be broken to melt diamond.
Sodium chloride has ionic bonding and a giant lattice structure.
Strong electrostatic attractions act between oppositely charged ions; accept between sodium ions, Na⁺, and chloride ions, Cl⁻.
Large amounts of energy are required to overcome the strong bonding or attractions in both structures.
